detailed_description:
Hina Cast: After Dark! [Early Development]

In Hina Cast: After Dark, you become Hina, a talented magician from the Osta Royal Institute! Live a double life as a diligent researcher by day and a rising star of ManaVision broadcasts by night!

[Current Development Status: This game is in early development, with only some features currently implemented]

**Currently Implemented Features:**

* Stage 1 with 2 basic monster types with h scene

* Hina's room with 1 event and 1 self-pleasure event

  • Total 4 H-Scene.

* Growth combat system with combo attacks, dodges, and parrying

※ This game contains adult content and is only playable by users 18 years of age or older. All characters in this game are 18 years of age or older.

Hina Cast : After Dark !

In Hina Cast: After Dark, you become Hina, a talented magician from the Osta Royal Institute! Live a double life as a diligent researcher by day and a rising star of ManaVision broadcasts by night!

Break free from the mundane and oppressive life at the research institute and build your fame and fortune in the world of ManaVision. Use flashy combos and magical skills to defeat dangerous magical beasts, level up, and grow stronger!

Explore a world full of dangers and temptations with the charming Hina. But be careful! Let your guard down and you might fall prey to the monsters, so quick reactions and strategic decisions are always necessary!

Your choices determine Hina's fate. Will you become a righteous magician, or choose a different path? Everything is in your hands!

Game Features:

  • Dynamic Combat System: Various combat mechanics including combo attacks, dodges, and parrying

  • Growth System: Continuously grow stronger through leveling up and learning new skills

  • Adventure with Charming Hina: Discover Hina's hidden talents through ManaVision and pave your way to success and popularity

※ This game contains adult content and is only playable by users 18 years of age or older. All characters in this game are 18 years of age or older.
